verdict: Organic presence is eroding across all three entities; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all lead generation activity this period came exclusively from Google Business Profile and organic search — no paid campaigns ran and no leads were recorded. Combined GBP actions totalled 370 this period, but each entity saw sharp week-over-week declines, with Forte down 85%, O'Hare down 48%, and search impressions falling across the board. The root cause is declining organic and local search visibility, and a Web/SEO root-cause fix is in progress to address the indexing issues driving this drop. The contact database and outreach sequencing work currently in motion will open a direct pipeline channel once complete, which is the expected turning point heading into October.

watch_item.issue: GBP and organic search visibility have declined sharply in the last 7 days across all three entities, with several profiles recording zero actions for 3–4 consecutive days.
watch_item.fix: A Web/SEO root-cause review is underway and a site reindexing effort is targeted for completion by end of October; outreach sequences are being prepared to generate direct pipeline activity while organic recovers.
